title: Behavioral Health & Isolation Countermeasure Protocol
trigger_patterns: Vocal prosody stress index or PVT reaction time degradation exceeds personal baseline band
Crew reports sleep disruption, persistent irritability, interpersonal friction, or cognitive fatigue
Prolonged isolation phase under multi-minute communication latency (> 10 min round-trip)

steps.text: Initiate autonomous offline psychological support module on personal crew tablet; all logs remain private and stored strictly on-device unless voluntarily shared.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demonstration protocol - not an operational NASA medical procedure

steps.text: Perform a 5-minute guided HRV coherence biofeedback and 4-7-8 respiratory pacing session (inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s) to downregulate autonomic sympathetic tone.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demonstration protocol - not an operational NASA medical procedure

steps.text: Activate sensory nature immersion: engage high-resolution dynamic terrestrial landscapes (forest canopy, ocean surf) with binaural acoustic soundscapes in crew quarters.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demonstration protocol - not an operational NASA medical procedure

steps.text: Adjust habitat circadian lighting: transition crew quarters luminaires to 2700K warm spectrum (zero 460-480 nm blue emission) 90 minutes before scheduled sleep.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demonstration protocol - not an operational NASA medical procedure

steps.text: Execute autonomous workload deconfliction: defer non-urgent maintenance work orders by 24 hours to create a guaranteed 60-minute personal privacy buffer.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demonstration protocol - not an operational NASA medical procedure

steps.text: Schedule asynchronous private voice message exchange with terrestrial psychological support team; tablet displays exact one-way light delay for message delivery expectations.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demonstration protocol - not an operational NASA medical procedure
